title: Radio-group error links resolve to the wrapper div, so the click handler's focus() silently no-ops — 'switch step, then focus' never focuses radio fields
detail: Radio-error anchors resolve to the group's wrapper div (no tabindex); HTMLElement.focus() on it silently no-ops, so the promised focus never lands for that field class — only the scroll works. The file's own tabindex=-1 legend trick shows the fix pattern.
recommended_fix: When the resolved target is a non-focusable wrapper, focus its first visible radio/input (or set tabindex=-1 before focusing); add a click-path test for radio anchors.

title: documents.gleam gains seven copy.* call sites with no import hunk, while situation.gleam in the same diff shows the import being added explicitly
detail: If documents.gleam did not already import copy, the branch does not compile; the diff neither shows nor can prove the pre-existing import. situation.gleam's +import copy proves new module usage needed explicit imports in this very diff.
recommended_fix: Confirm documents.gleam's import block already includes copy (the build fails loudly if not); no change needed if pre-existing.

title: New SSR tests call form_pages.view_form_with_errors three times, but the diff adds no import to form_view_test.gleam
detail: If the pre-existing 403-line test file never imported form_pages, the test build fails. Unverifiable from a hunk that starts at line 403; the contrast with situation.gleam's explicit +import copy makes it worth one check.
recommended_fix: Confirm form_view_test.gleam imports application/form_pages; add the import if absent.

title: Preflight hold keys on submit-application / documents-section-error testids and data-preflight-blocked — none established anywhere in this diff
evidence:
+      var submitBtn = doc.querySelector('[data-testid="submit-application"]');
+      if (
+        submitBtn &&
+        submitBtn.hasAttribute("data-preflight-blocked") &&

+        var banner = sections[i].el.querySelector(
+          '[data-testid="documents-section-error"]'
+        );
detail: If form.js/SSR name these hooks differently, the hold never triggers (the dead-end it prevents returns) or the banner never scrolls into view; both failures are silent. No test in this chunk pins the contract.
recommended_fix: Pin the banner/submit testids and the data-preflight-blocked attribute with a test, or defensively fall back to a class/role selector.

title: Synthetic event uses bare global Event while the same file root-qualifies CustomEvent
evidence:
+      sections[i].el.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));

+          new root.CustomEvent(EVENT_STEP_CHANGED, { detail: detail })
detail: The file's own pattern qualifies globals through root for non-browser execution; the unqualified Event breaks that pattern and throws ReferenceError in any harness where Event is not a global binding.
recommended_fix: Use new root.Event("input", { bubbles: true }) for consistency with root.CustomEvent.

title: btn-step-continue hover uses hard-coded #C08425 — the only non-var() color in the entire added stylesheet
detail: Every other rule in the new CSS consumes theme variables; the hard-coded amber hover silently opts out of theming and will drift if --amber is ever redefined.
recommended_fix: Define and use a --amber-hover (or color-mix) variable instead of the literal hex.

title: .stepper-nav:empty rule can never fire — every nav row gets at least one button
detail: initBrowser bails below two sections; with two or more, every index satisfies i>0 (Back) or i<length-1 (Continue), so no nav row is ever empty. The rule is unreachable as written.
recommended_fix: Drop the rule, or keep it with a comment stating it is purely defensive.
